nom: r.e.m. beauty Full Night's Sleep Cooling Blurring Undereye Balm

segments.oily: One reviewer with an oily nose used the balm as a full-face primer and reported it kept makeup fresh for hours in humid weather.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin describe the balm as moisturizing and well suited to nighttime use, though one reported new small dry patches after a breakout.
segments.sensitive: Sensitive-skin reviewers are split: several report gentle results with no irritation and reduced puffiness, while others describe breakouts, milia, small dry patches, or a burning sensation.
segments.mature: A reviewer in her 50s reports the balm blurs eye wrinkles, and another in her 40s finds it dries out the under-eye skin and disrupts makeup wear.

concerns.aging: Reviewers report visibly reduced fine lines, wrinkles, and a smoother, more youthful under-eye appearance with regular use; no dissent noted on this concern specifically.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers describe the balm as hydrating, cooling, and soothing for tired or dry under-eyes, but a few report it fails to hydrate, dries out after opening, or leaves skin drier than before.
concerns.redness: One reviewer reports the balm dramatically reduced facial redness within minutes when used beyond the eye area, though this is a single, isolated account.
concerns.barrier: A small number of reviewers with sensitive skin report breakouts, milia, dry patches, or burning, suggesting barrier irritation for some users despite most reporting no such issues.
concerns.spots: Reviewers report reduced appearance of dark circles and dark spots under the eyes with regular use, describing brighter, less noticeable discoloration over weeks; no strong dissent found.
concerns.blemishes: A minority of reviewers report the product caused milia or breakouts under the eyes, while the majority report no blemish-related issues.
concerns.oiliness: Reviewers report the product is not greasy and absorbs without residue; one reviewer used it to help control an oily nose area as part of a full-face primer routine.

aspects.libelle: Small jar, quick to run out
No applicator, dug out with fingers
